meta.title: Messages | Invessiv
meta.description: Every customer conversation in one place: who wrote, what is still unread and who replies.

thread.emptyBody: What you write here, the customer reads in their portal – and can reply right away.
thread.inputHint: Enter sends, Shift + Enter starts a new line.

systemMessages.projectPhaseChanged: Project “{projectTitle}” is now in the {phase} phase.

states.loadError: The conversation could not be loaded.
states.olderError: Older messages could not be loaded.
states.attachmentFailed: An attachment can't be shared with the customer, for example because its project is archived. Remove it and send again.

redaction.title: Hide this message?
redaction.description: The content disappears for everyone – the customer included – and cannot be restored. The conversation keeps a notice, and the activity log records who hid it.
redaction.error: The message could not be hidden. Please try again.

inbox.heading: Messages
inbox.intro: Each customer has exactly one conversation. It also appears in the customer record and in the customer's portal.
inbox.emptyBody: As soon as you write to a customer or they write to you from the portal, the conversation appears here.
inbox.emptyFilteredTitle: No conversation you are responsible for
inbox.emptyFilteredBody: Show all conversations or take over responsibility in one of them.
inbox.selectPrompt: Pick a conversation on the left.

owner.label: Responsible
owner.conflict: Someone just changed the responsible person. The current state is shown.
owner.invalid: This person cannot read the conversation or is no longer active.
owner.error: The responsible person could not be changed.

attachments.loadError: The files could not be loaded.
attachments.downloadError: This attachment can't be downloaded right now. Reload the conversation.
attachments.uploadTitle: Upload a file for the chat
attachments.uploadDescription: The file is stored customer-wide under “Files” and then attached to your message. Sending shares it with the customer.
attachments.pickerDescription: Files and links of this customer. Internal entries are shared with the customer when you send.
attachments.empty: This customer has no files or links yet.
attachments.releaseNoticeOne: This file will be shared with the customer.
attachments.releaseNoticeMany: These files will be shared with the customer.
